guidance_for_write_dockerfile_agent: The Docker build is failing at the step: RUN update-alternatives --install /usr/bin/python3 python3 /usr/bin/python3 1 with the error: "update-alternatives: <link> and <path> can't be the same". This happens because the command attempts to register /usr/bin/python3 as an alternative pointing to itself, which is invalid. To fix this, remove this RUN update-alternatives command from the Dockerfile. The base Ubuntu 22.04 image already provides python3 pointing to python3.10. This command is unnecessary and causes build failure. After this fix, the build should succeed, allowing the virtual environment and dependencies to install properly.
